source.detourmap: Detourmap Places v1.1.0 (2026), sourced from Wikidata with Commons photos and English Wikipedia, CC0 data.

notes: The destination layer is a static 6,000-anchor index; the spot layer is a deduplicated real-POI master table.
Major destinations use a wider radius to surface genuine nearby getaways and day-trip material, with distance stored so the UI can distinguish in-city spots from excursions.
Preferred timing is an experience-oriented recommendation, not a claim of venue opening hours unless confidence is explicitly high on a curated record.
Wikimedia image URLs in the base dataset point to real Commons files; individual file licenses should be respected before redistribution.
